note: LB.4a + LB.4b (legacy-only). Two flask services (services/admin, services/users, each with its own pyproject.toml) serve /health in ONE repo, and a web/ (package.json) axios client calls http://users-svc:8080/health. Baseline at aa91f3c (debug CLI): one ROUTE `GET /health` HANDLED_BY both admin_health and users_health, and the endpoint is `endpoint:GET:/health`. LB.4a qualifies every ROUTE / ENDPOINT / page node under a nested project root with ` @<project path>`, so each service keeps its own route; after LB.4a alone the forbid HTTP_CALLS row is violated (the client pairs with both owners). LB.4b: the host `users-svc` names the `users` PROJECT (label and directory name), so the client pairs only with that project's route.
